classification.immutable: A mudança silenciosa altera significado, segurança, legalidade, wire compatibility ou autoridade.
classification.extension_limited: A extensão é aditiva somente dentro de limites documentados; consumidores antigos devem rejeitar ou ignorar de forma segura.
classification.migratable: A mudança exige versão explícita, migração, rollback e teste de corrupção/interrupção.
classification.experimental: Não é contrato de produto e não pode ganhar autoridade por compatibilidade acidental.

contracts.allowed_extension: unknown role ids are skipped; explicitly reserved/padded space may be used only without moving airtime or offsets
contracts.breaking_change: field offsets, crypto tier, airtime, address semantics, replay/dedup or meaning of an existing id
contracts.authority: transport can transmit only after upstream interaction/assurance handoff

contracts.current_contract: schemaVersion=1; closed event/source enums; additionalProperties=false; authority=PROPOSAL_ONLY
contracts.allowed_extension: new version with explicit parser/migration and old-version fixture
contracts.breaking_change: new event, field, source or authority accepted by version 1 without migration
contracts.authority: proposal only; no direct memory, radio, confirmation or transport path

contracts.current_contract: finite Portuguese grammar; transcript max 96 bytes; ARRIVE/HELP/CANCEL; recognized speech creates only local draft or local cancel
contracts.allowed_extension: add exact controlled phrases that preserve one-intent parsing, bounded slots and confirmation requirement
contracts.breaking_change: accept an embedded keyword, infer an external intent, coerce numeric input or produce a transport-ready state
contracts.authority: draft only; every draft requires separate physical confirmation

contracts.current_contract: version 1; 22-byte header + 5-byte typed payload + 16-byte tag = 43-byte wire envelope; pair, direction, sequence, expiry and session binding
contracts.allowed_extension: reuse declared typed payload capacity or introduce a new version and explicit decoder behavior
contracts.breaking_change: wire length, replay/expiry/session semantics, authentication boundary or transcript/audio/HCP insertion
contracts.authority: typed observation reaches intent gateway only; envelope cannot send

contracts.current_contract: physical PTT starts capture; ASR reaches AWAIT_CONFIRM; only confirmed draft reaches application handoff; one-shot send
contracts.allowed_extension: append diagnostic metrics or UX states without bypassing existing transitions; preserve zeroization/timeouts
contracts.breaking_change: ASR or adapter reaches READY_SEND without confirmation, repeated send, or automatic session reactivation
contracts.authority: sole portable handoff to application; link_send remains separate

contracts.current_contract: version 1; minimal typed cards; collection max 8; generation/floor recovery; purpose-bound physical session and explicit human authorization
contracts.allowed_extension: new storage version with authenticated migration, floor preservation, rollback and blocked ambiguity
contracts.breaking_change: implicit candidate/model/radio write, semantic enumeration, loss of generation floor or reactivation after reboot
contracts.authority: vault/collection writes require independent human authorization and physical session

contracts.current_contract: declared local input digests, strict mismatch failure, external attestation not claimed
contracts.allowed_extension: add protected stable inputs or improve the manifest schema with a migration
contracts.breaking_change: silently ignore stale digest, include self-referential mutable evidence tree or claim external attestation without evidence
contracts.authority: audit control only; never runtime authority

authority_paths.required_gate: typed observation, active PTT session, confidence/margin/context rules
one physical confirmation and transport fields set after handoff
explicit card/receipt-bound authorization and purpose-bound session
none; external labels have zero HERUS command authority

conclusion: The architecture already supports incremental evolution at explicit seams, but Semantic IR, wire formats and persistence are not universally backward compatible. The Swiss-watch principle is valid only as contract preservation plus versioned migration, not as a ban on breaking security fixes or internal replacement.
